environment.release_boundary: probe process exit after device synchronization and output retention

plan.question: Whether unchanged device input snapshots and a scalar-source FP32 path localize the observed exactness failure
plan.acceptance: Retain all complete numerical results. Exact oracle unchanged; checker diagnostic failures remain failures. No performance acceptance or predetermined scalar/WMMA outcome. Unexpected input snapshot or guard corruption stops later device phases for triage.
plan.limitations: Three snapshots establish input equality only at those capture boundaries. Same WMMA source body does not assert unchanged binary. Scalar source does not establish scalar ISA. No unique hardware attribution.

invalid_cases.error_message: Shape outside the fixed WMMA boundary cases
Packed input words differ from the declared A-row/B-column contract

correctness.tested_contract: All captured input halfwords equal prepared/fixed packing; every full 16x16 FP32 output is finite and exactly equal to the logical integer dot /256, signed zeros equivalent; all guards intact.
correctness.analysis_scope: frozen checker/source replay of every actual input snapshot and C output; not an independently implemented arithmetic review

measurement.scope: raw per-variant event/host batches retained descriptively; no speedup or numerical failure accepted as performance
measurement.trace_scope: actual WMMA64-thread and scalar256-thread groups each have 110 events and independently exclude their ten warmups

protocol.comparison: finite exact numeric equality; signed zero equivalent; no tolerance

protocol.transfer_scope: CPU packing, allocation, H2D/D2H copies, reset, attribute queries and file writes excluded
protocol.cache_policy: repeated addresses; no explicit application cache reset; runtime cache policy unknown
protocol.interpretation: descriptive full tile kernel; no native-instruction throughput or end-to-end GEMM claim
protocol.pointer_alignment_scope: largest power of two dividing each observed device address; no imported alignment requirement

limitations: Kernel names, geometry and resource descriptors are observations; they do not prove actual occupancy, physical allocation or instruction selection.
A valid trace does not establish matrix-output correctness; retain the paired probe's independent CPU checker outcome separately.
Profiled raw durations are retained without conversion and are not accepted as comparative performance evidence.
The inspector checks the caller's declared variant order and known220-launch protocol; it does not infer K from the trace.

artifacts.public_projection: all prepared A/B uint16 words, every before/between/after input echo, all complete C uint32 words including guards, 620 raw timing batches, complete numerical mismatches, actual prior-WMMA word comparisons and grouped resource trace
artifacts.prior_comparison: retained first-sweep/runs/sweep at its own recorded source; comparison booleans are observations, not enforced equality

limitations: Prepared inputs and three snapshots establish equality at capture boundaries only, not transient values inside either kernel.
The scalar source uses float operands/accumulator; its observed results do not establish a forced IEEE instruction sequence or prohibit contraction.
An unchanged WMMA source body does not establish unchanged emitted code, binary or resource behavior.
A path-specific numerical difference narrows this diagnosis but does not uniquely identify hardware, compiler, SDK or internal arithmetic as its cause.
Every exact failure remains a failure under the original integer-dot/256 oracle; no tolerance is introduced and no performance is accepted.
Legacy regression, paired unprofiled runs and the paired trace remain separately labeled; timings and resource descriptors are not occupancy, physical allocation or throughput proofs.
One C550/native software stack, deterministic packed FP16 data, one output tile and bounded K; no arbitrary precision or framework GEMM qualification.
